Description: Pages and layouts render on the server unless a file opts in; that keeps JavaScript out of the bundle.
Do: Fetch and render in server components.
Don't: Add use client to every file.
Code Good: export default async function Page(){const d=await getData();return <List d={d}/>}
Code Bad: 'use client' // on a page that only shows data

Guideline: Push use client to small leaves
Description: The directive pulls the whole import graph into the client bundle.
Do: Make the interactive button its own client file.
Don't: Mark the layout as client for one hook.

Guideline: Pass server content as children to client wrappers
Description: A client component can render server-made children without bundling them.
Do: Nest server components inside a client provider via children.
Don't: Import a server component into a client file.
Code Bad: import Heavy from './Heavy' // in client file

Guideline: Keep server-only code from the client
Description: A package marker makes the build fail if secrets reach client code.
Do: Import server-only in modules that use secrets.
Don't: Read process.env secrets in shared utils.

Description: Data close to the render path avoids client waterfalls and keeps keys private.
Do: Await the call in the component.
Don't: Use an effect in a client component for first load data.

Description: Awaiting one after another doubles wait time.
Do: Use Promise.all for independent loads.
Don't: Await sequentially when there is no dependency.
Code Bad: const a=await getA(); const b=await getB()

Description: A loading boundary lets the shell paint while a slow query finishes.
Do: Wrap the slow component in Suspense.
Don't: Hold the whole page for one query.

Guideline: Add a loading.tsx for route-level streaming
Description: The file creates an instant fallback for navigation.
Do: Put a skeleton in loading.tsx.
Don't: Leave a blank screen between routes.

Description: Next 16 does not cache by default; opt in with the cache directive or settings.
Do: Mark cacheable work and set a lifetime.
Don't: Assume old fetch caching still applies.

Description: After a write, tell Next which cached data is stale.
Do: Call revalidatePath or revalidateTag in the action.
Don't: Reload the page with window.location.

Guideline: Tag cached data you will refresh
Description: Tags let an action refresh just the related entries.
Do: Attach a tag, then revalidate that tag.
Don't: Revalidate the whole site for a menu edit.

Guideline: Use Server Actions for form writes
Description: An action runs on the server and works with a plain form before JavaScript loads.
Do: Use action on form with a use server function.
Don't: Post JSON to a hand-written route for each form.

Guideline: Validate and authorise inside every action
Description: Actions are reachable endpoints.
Do: Parse input and check the user in the action.
Don't: Trust hidden fields.

Description: Return field errors from the action and render them near the field.
Do: Return an errors object.
Don't: Throw for validation failures.

Description: redirect works by throwing; catching it swallows the redirect.
Do: Call redirect after the try block.
Don't: Call it inside catch-all try.

Guideline: Use the Form component for GET forms
Description: next/form prefetches and navigates client-side for search forms.
Do: Use Form with an action path for searches.
Don't: Handle search with onSubmit and location.

Description: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 and 3.3.1 need programmatic labels and error text.
Do: Pair label and input; link errors with aria-describedby.
Don't: Use placeholders as labels.

Guideline: Booking form: confirm and keep the data
Description: After a booking, show a confirmation page with the details and email the user.
Do: Redirect to a thanks page with the booking reference.
Don't: Leave the form blank with no message.

Description: Link prefetches and does client navigation.
Do: Use next/link.
Don't: Use anchor tags for in-app pages.

Description: A tel link must not go through Link or router push.
Do: Use an a element with tel:.
Don't: Wrap tel in next/link.

Guideline: Use route groups and layouts for structure
Description: Parenthesised folders organise without changing URLs.
Do: Group marketing and app routes.
Don't: Copy the header into every page.

Description: Segments need friendly fallbacks for missing data and failures.
Do: Call notFound() and write not-found.tsx and error.tsx.
Don't: Return null for missing records.

Guideline: error.tsx must be a client component
Description: Error boundaries need the reset function and run in the browser.
Do: Add use client and offer a retry.
Don't: Write error.tsx as a server file.

Guideline: Use proxy for cheap request checks only
Description: The proxy file (formerly middleware) runs before routes; keep it light.
Do: Redirect or rewrite from the request.
Don't: Run heavy database work there.

Description: Reading search params in a client component can force client rendering of the page.
Do: Wrap the component in Suspense.
Don't: Use it at page top without a boundary.

Description: It resizes, serves modern formats and reserves space.
Do: Give width and height or fill with a sized parent.
Don't: Use raw img for large photos.

Guideline: Mark the LCP image as preload
Description: The hero should load first, not lazily.
Do: Use the preload prop on the single hero image.
Don't: Leave the hero lazy.

Description: sizes lets the browser pick the right file for the layout.
Do: Set sizes for responsive images.
Don't: Omit sizes on fill images.

Description: Remote image domains need an allow-list to prevent abuse of the optimizer.
Do: List remotePatterns narrowly.
Don't: Allow every host.

Description: Informative images need text alternatives; decorative get empty alt (SC 1.1.1).
Do: Describe what the image shows.
Don't: Skip alt or use the file name.

Description: It downloads at build time, serves from your domain, and prevents layout shift.
Do: Load with next/font and apply the class.
Don't: Link a Google Fonts stylesheet in head.

Description: Each weight is a file.
Do: List the weights you use.
Don't: Load a variable font full range for one weight.

Description: Mixing global CSS, modules and utilities makes specificity unpredictable.
Do: Use CSS Modules or Tailwind consistently.
Don't: Mix three systems on one page.

Guideline: Import global CSS once, in the root layout
Description: Global styles belong to app/layout.
Do: Import globals.css in layout.
Don't: Import global CSS in components.

Description: Disable non-essential animation when the user asks (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3).
Do: Wrap motion in a media query.
Don't: Autoplay large movement.

Description: Title and description drive search results and sharing.
Do: Export metadata or generateMetadata.
Don't: Hand-write head tags in each page.
Code Good: export const metadata={title:'Plumber in Leeds',description:'Same-day repairs'}

Description: Dynamic pages need unique titles from the record.
Do: Use generateMetadata with the same fetch.
Don't: Reuse one title everywhere.
Code Good: export async function generateMetadata({params}){const p=await getPost((await params).slug);return {title:p.title}}

Description: Shared links look better with a purpose-made image.
Do: Add opengraph-image file or metadata.
Don't: Let links share a blank card.

Description: JSON-LD helps search show hours, phone and address.
Do: Render a script type application/ld+json with LocalBusiness.
Don't: Hide the address in an image.
Code Bad: phone only in a banner image

Description: Strategy controls when a script runs.
Do: Use afterInteractive or lazyOnload.
Don't: Put analytics in a blocking head tag.

Description: Chat widgets and trackers hurt INP and LCP.
Do: Add one at a time and measure.
Don't: Install six tag-manager snippets.

Description: Dynamic import defers code until it is needed.
Do: Use next/dynamic or lazy for maps and editors.
Don't: Import a map on first paint.

Description: The analyzer shows what ships to the browser.
Do: Run the bundle analyzer before release.
Don't: Ship without looking.

Description: Real-user numbers beat lab guesses.
Do: Use useReportWebVitals or the platform's analytics.
Don't: Guess from desktop Lighthouse only.

Description: Logging and emails can run after the response is sent.
Do: Wrap background work in after.
Don't: Await analytics before responding.

Guideline: Use NEXT_PUBLIC only for public values
Description: Prefixed variables are inlined into the browser bundle.
Do: Keep secrets unprefixed.
Don't: Prefix a secret key.

Description: A nonce-based policy limits injected scripts.
Do: Generate a nonce in the proxy and pass it.
Don't: Use unsafe-inline everywhere.

Description: Headers like X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are cheap hardening.
Do: Use headers() in next.config.
Don't: Rely on defaults.

Guideline: Read cookies and headers on the server
Description: cookies() and headers() are async in current versions and make a route dynamic.
Do: Await them in server code.
Don't: Read document.cookie for a session.

Description: A layout check is bypassed by partial rendering; verify where data is read.
Do: Verify in a data access layer.
Don't: Protect only in layout.

Description: Session cookies must not be script-readable and should stay on HTTPS.
Do: Set httpOnly, secure and sameSite lax.
Don't: Store a JWT in localStorage.

Description: Rolling your own password handling is risky.
Do: Pick a library that fits the app.
Don't: Hash passwords with a bare fast hash.

Guideline: Stripe Checkout from a route handler or action
Description: Create the session on the server so the price is yours.
Do: Create it in a server action and redirect to session.url.
Don't: Trust a price from the client.

Guideline: Verify the Stripe webhook on the raw body
Description: Signature check needs the unparsed body.
Do: Read request.text() and construct the event.
Don't: Parse JSON before verifying.

Description: Handlers follow the web Request/Response API.
Do: Export GET or POST functions.
Don't: Use pages-router handlers in app.

Description: Handlers take outside data.
Do: Parse with a schema and return 400.
Don't: Pass body straight to the database.

Description: Next announces route changes to assistive tech from the page title or h1.
Do: Give each page a clear title and h1.
Don't: Leave pages with the same title.

Description: Next ships eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y rules to catch common faults.
Do: Fix its warnings.
Don't: Disable the rules.

Description: Keyboard users need to bypass the header (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1).
Do: Add a skip link and a main landmark in the layout.
Don't: Put all content in divs.

Guideline: Use output standalone for Docker hosting
Description: A trimmed server build lowers image size.
Do: Set output standalone for container deploys.
Don't: Copy node_modules whole.

Description: The instrumentation file runs once at startup.
Do: Register tracing there.
Don't: Patch globals in a page.

Guideline: Set a stable Server Actions encryption key for multi-instance hosts
Description: Closure variables are encrypted per build; instances must share a key.
Do: Set NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
Don't: Deploy several instances with random keys.

Description: Screen readers pick pronunciation from lang (SC 3.1.1).
Do: Set lang in root layout.
Don't: Leave it empty.

Description: generateStaticParams pre-renders dynamic routes for fast pages.
Do: Return slugs for known pages.
Don't: Render every page on demand when content is static.
